chunks: And Hell made visible to him who can see,

key_terms.الْجَحِيمُ: Hellfire; a specific level or name for Hell in Islamic eschatology
key_terms.لِمَن يَرَىٰ: To him who sees; referring to those with spiritual perception or insight

ai.seo_question: What does it mean for Hell to be 'made visible' to those who can see?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Tajalli* (manifestation), where the reality of the Hereafter becomes visible to the eyes of the heart before the physical resurrection. It underscores the justice of divine punishment, as the fire is not merely a created place but a revealed truth for those whose spiritual vision (*Basirah*) has been awakened by faith or awakened by their deeds.
